title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Secret
author: StoryGen Community
markdown:
On a rocky cliff, where the sea met the sky, stood an old lighthouse that nobody visited anymore. But Mira knew it held a secret.

Every evening, when the sun dipped below the horizon, Mira would climb the winding stone steps inside the lighthouse tower. Round and round she went, her footsteps echoing off the cold walls, until she reached the very top.

There, in the lantern room, lived a tiny dragon named Ember. He was no bigger than a teacup, with scales that shimmered like opals and wings as thin as tissue paper.

"Good evening, Ember," Mira whispered, pulling a jar of fireflies from her coat pocket. "I brought your favourite."

Ember chirped happily, his tail curling with delight. He breathed a gentle puff of warm air over Mira's cold hands, and she laughed.

"The fishermen say the lighthouse light hasn't worked in years," Mira told him. "But I know the truth."

Every night, when the fog rolled in thick across the harbour, Ember would sit in the centre of the great glass lens and glow. His little body blazed with a warm, golden light that filled the lantern room and spilled out across the dark water, guiding the fishing boats safely home.

The fishermen thought someone had fixed the old lamp. They never guessed that the lighthouse keeper's secret was a teacup dragon with a heart full of light.
characters: Mira (a brave girl), Ember (a teacup dragon)
